scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and standalone exact-rational finite checks supplied; correctness and literature comparisons have undergone self-review only; no independent audit, certification or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact expression and eventual short-arc optimum assume exactly two perfectly immune vertices of a simple cycle, independently seeded unvaccinated vertices at probability q in (0,1), and independent transmissible undirected bonds at probability p in (0,1); it does not assert the same for correlated seeds, nonperfect vaccines, other graph families, or spectral reproduction-number minimization.
title: Finite-gap optimal vaccination on cycles with independent epidemic seeds
